TC-13/S28.title: When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, non-default panel states
TC-13/S28.detail: (a) both modes, thrown + unreadable: button back to Photograph, nothing saved, Paste and retry work; FAIL: the thrown error shows the raw server text '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (B17 still), and the photo error has no role=alert / live region. (b) both modes pass: clear 'Prior note saved, but extraction failed…' (role=alert), note kept, Extract Fields fills; in-process: Haiku throttled ×2 → Mistral answers and is logged with fellBackFrom; all-fail rejects and logs. (c) axe violations in the paste-open / expanded / error states (contrast, P2 own check).
